name: lab-unit

irregularities.what: Fallback Local (TACACS+) is On (Transport failure) (the device has: On (All failures))

irregularities.action: Left alone. To remove it later: /N 28 3 (Secondary host/address), then 1 (IPv4), then <SPACE><CR>
Left alone. To remove it later: /N 25 8 (Read/Write Community), then <SPACE><CR>

region: # At the unit's prompt type /N and Enter. For each step type the item numbers of its second column,
# one at a time with Enter after each, then what the arrow says. A pick: the number of the line
# that reads as shown. ESC goes back one level. A value is live as soon as its Enter is accepted.
#  2. ESC ESC  leave /N: wait for "Saving configuration to flash"
#  3. CHECK from a SECOND session (this one stays open): log in as a member of scope lab and type
#      /H; the help lists the commands of the level the server assigned (Step 8 of tacctl config
#      wti). Go on only when it does.
after: # Check now. The unit has no rollback: nothing undoes this by itself.
#   From the tacctl server:   tacctl device config pull lab-unit --diff     (aaa: ok)
#   In a second session:      log in as a member of scope lab and type /H (the help lists the commands of the assigned level), then /X
# To undo it: tacctl device config plan lab-unit --backout (the steps with the values the pull
# showed; tacctl keeps this plan's back-out until the next plan with changes).
# Do not: paste anything outside the banners; paste a block into another unit; leave /N with ESC
# before the last step of the list; keep this output in a file after the paste when it holds a
# Locked out (the paste cut your session and no login works)? A superuser runs: tacctl breakglass hold lab-unit --reason "..."
# then log in on the unit's serial console as its local Administrator account,
# fix or back out, and the superuser runs: tacctl breakglass release lab-unit
backout: # At the unit's prompt type /N and Enter. For each step type the item numbers of its second column,
# one at a time with Enter after each, then what the arrow says. A pick: the number of the line
# that reads as shown. ESC goes back one level. A value is live as soon as its Enter is accepted.
#  2. ESC ESC  leave /N: wait for "Saving configuration to flash"
warnings: Step 1 changes what the unit asks of the TACACS+ server or how it answers when the server fails: a wrong secret word, host, port or service name does not stop a login, it returns every login to the unit's Default User Access level, and Fallback Local decides whether the unit's own accounts work when the server does not answer; keep the serial session open and do the check after the ESC step before anything else
cleanup_deferred: cleanup comes after this region is pasted and verified: pull the device, then plan --converge again
